caption: The drawing consists of a large square subdivided into smaller squares arranged in a grid pattern, featuring repeated eight-pointed star shapes. The top left quadrant is dominated by an enlarged eight-pointed star constructed from three main types of patterned sections: reddish-brown decorated sections with white floral and vine motifs for some star points and rectangular segments, pale gray sections with a crosshatched grid pattern for alternating star points and background, and a beige area with stylized light brown leafy designs forming a border along the top and left edges. The lower portion of the composition contains a checkerboard pattern made of alternating small squares and star motifs; the star motifs are rendered in various shades of reddish-brown, peach, orange, and mustard yellow, with some stars featuring detailed linework and others solidly filled. The background squares of the checkerboard are pale pinkish-gray. The image is framed by double thin borders: an inner white margin and a faintly outlined outer border.
title: Pieced and Quilted Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
